P.name: Rock Surfing
P.title: Template:Data Taliyah/Rock Surfing
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Rock Surfing|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Taliyah
|skill        = I
|icon         = Rock Surfing.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Taliyah}} gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while near [[terrain]]. This effect will be put on {{sti|cooldown}} while in combat or casting an ability.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} While near [[terrain]], '''Taliyah''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10;15;25;40|1;9;12;15|key=%}}|ms}}}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}, which builds up over 1 second while in range for at least {{fd|0.4}} seconds, and decays {{tt|at the same rate|See notes}} once out of range for at least 3 seconds.
|description2 = If '''Taliyah''' is casting an {{tip|ability}} or enters [[combat status|champion combat]], ''Rock Surfing'' cannot occur again for a few seconds.
|static       = 2
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* The movement speed builds up and decays linearly (by the same amount in the same interval), 25% of the maximum value every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
* ''Rock Surfing'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* Dealing {{tip|default damage|default}} or {{tip|proc damage|proc}} damage does not put ''Rock Surfing'' on cooldown.
}}

R.name: Weaver's Wall
R.title: Template:Data Taliyah/Weaver's Wall
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Weaver's Wall|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Taliyah |skill = R |icon = Weaver's Wall.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Taliyah}} summons a torrent of spiraling rocks that cascades in the target direction, which {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} champions hit and erects a wall of [[terrain]] in its wake. The wall lasts a few seconds before slowly disintegrating from the starting end. |blurb2 = '''Taliyah''' will also briefly {{tip|channel}}, during which ''Weaver's Wall'' can be recast. While the wall remains fully formed, she gains another recast empowered with a new effect. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} After the channel, '''Taliyah''' will {{tip|dash|surf}} along the wall as it erects. She can move to {{tip|dash|exit}} the wall early, and automatically does so upon being {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or reaching the finishing end.

{{sbc|Empowered Recast:}} '''Taliyah''' instantly destroys the wall. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' summons a torrent of spiraling rocks that cascades in the target direction, {{tip|airborne|knocking aside}} champions hit and erecting a wall of [[terrain]] in its wake. The wall lasts for 4 seconds after completion, then slowly disintegrates from its starting point. |description2 = '''Taliyah''' also {{tip|channels}} for 1 second, during which ''Weaver's Wall'' can be recast and she {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself. |icon3 = Weaver's Wall 2.png |description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} Upon completing the {{tip|channel}}, '''Taliyah''' {{tip|dash|surfs}} on the wall as it emerges, {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself in the process. After {{fd|0.75}} seconds, she may input a movement command to {{tip|dash|jump}} off the wall {{tt|to the target location|Will cast at maximum range (clamped) if ordered location is beyond this jump off command's range}}, and automatically does so upon being {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|silence|silenced}} or reaching maximum range.

Once the wall has fully formed, '''Taliyah''' can recast to destroy the wall instantly. |description4 = ''Weaver's Wall'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second}} {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} upon taking {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|turret}} damage. |cooldown = {{tt|{{ap|180 to 120}}|Starts after wall expires or is destroyed}} |cdstart = post-effect |cost = 100 |costtype = Mana |cast time = none |speed = {{dv|1500|{{tt|1200|Jump off dash speed}}}} |target range = {{dv|{{tt|{{ap|2500 to 6500}}|Wall length}}|{{tt|900|Jump off command range}}}} |range = {{dv|{{tt|700|Jump off maximum dash distance}}|{{tt|1000|Maximum extended jump off dash distance across terrain}}}} |queue time = {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Initial cast}} |targeting = {{dv|[[Direction-targeted|Direction]]|[[Auto-targeted|Auto]]}} |affects = Self, Enemies |projectile = true |spellshield = false |grounded = special |knockdown = True |terraingrace = true |silence = true |notes = * If a champion is standing next to a portion of the generated terrain and that portion expires by any means, enemies' {{tip|spell shield}} will be consumed.{{bug}} * The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive. ** However neither recasts do. * '''Taliyah''' can recast to destroy the wall even if she did not surf it or it is in the process of disintegrating. * '''Taliyah''' almost always jumps off of the wall to her left from when it reaches maximum range. If she is forced to jump off of the wall, she will do so towards the source that dealt damage or applied the crowd control to her. * ''Weaver's Wall'', while {{tip|channel|channeling}}, can be recast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} but not while {{tip|root|rooted}}. ** The channel cannot be started while affected by either crowd control effects. * {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} will prevent ''Weaver's Wall'' from summoning any further but does not destroy any initial terrain it spawned. If '''Taliyah''' is surfing during the collision, she immediately becomes {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, interrupting the surf. * If '''Taliyah''' would enter terrain and the wall reaches maximum range inside, she is preemptively forced off the wall before entering. ** The wall can surpass the edges of the map, but '''Taliyah''' cannot. * The following table refers for interactions while '''Taliyah''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}: ** The channel is not {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|ground}} despite being a [[Channel#Movement Channels|movement channel]]. ** This lockout persists for another {{fd|0.65}} seconds during the surf after the channel is completed. {{ct|channel|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|consume=false|items=false|spells=false,false,false,false,false|interrupts=death, root, silence}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Taliyah''' is {{tip|dash|surfing}} after the first {{tt|{{fd|0.65}} seconds|Estimated}}. ** Once {{fd|0.35}} seconds have elapsed afterwards, her lockout is modified for the rest of the surf. {{ct|channel|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|consume=false|items=false|spells=interrupts,false,false,false,false|interrupts=death, root, silence}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Taliyah''' is {{tip|dash|surfing}} after 1 second from the channel's completion. ** Interrupting the surf by casting a non-auto targeted ability, spell, or item active causes her to jump off the wall to the location of where the spell was targeted. She will dash to maximum range if the spell was cast outside of it. {{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|move=interrupts|cast=interrupts|consume=interrupts|items=interrupts|spells=interrupts|interrupts=death, root, silence}} |flavorsound = {{sm2|Taliyah_Original_R_4.ogg}} ''"Let's shake things up."'' }}
